summary.headline: Judgments of Two Nativities
summary.text: Astrological judgments of two nativities: a nocturnal nativity with Cancer ascending, whose triplicity lords indicate poverty moderated by Jupiter into a mediocre religious life, followed by a diurnal nativity with Gemini ascending and the Sun’s triplicity lords signifying fortune.
